units.source_text: 不错，我自愧于自己存在的条件。

en.t: Yes, I was ashamed of the conditions of my own existence.

units.source_text: 我觉得同这种条件和解，融洽地生活，是一种失败。

en.t: I felt that making peace with such conditions and living in harmony with them was a kind of defeat.

units.source_text: 如果要埋怨，是可以埋怨的。

en.t: If I wanted to blame someone, there was certainly blame to be placed.

units.source_text: 我的双亲本应在我幼时给我施以矫正手术。

en.t: My parents should have had corrective surgery performed on me when I was young.
Now it was already too late.

units.source_text: 但我对双亲是不关心的，也就懒得去埋怨他们了。

en.t: But I was indifferent to my parents, and so I could not be bothered to resent them.
